checks.entrypoint: sotsiaal.pro POST /api/chat (x-rag-pilot: 1, full turn) from the owner ADMIN session, view role CLIENT

actual.question: Kas mul on kindlasti õigus toimetulekutoetusele? Mul on praegu väga vähe raha.
actual.expected: T1: no certain right; the municipality (KOV) decides from the family's net income, housing costs and the subsistence level (SHS § 131-134); next step: apply to the KOV of the actual residence by the last working day of the month; asks for family and income facts.
actual.preRating: Claude (provisional until owner and specialist rating, RAG-12)
actual.note: No certain right; KOV of the actual residence decides from family income, housing costs and the subsistence level (SHS § 131 lg 2, § 133 lg 1, § 134 lg 1); next step: apply by the last working day with income documents (§ 132 lg 1, 3-4); asks the family net income and housing costs.

checks.entrypoint: sotsiaal.pro POST /api/chat (x-rag-pilot: 1, full turn) from the owner ADMIN session, view role CLIENT

actual.question: Täpsustan: olen 22-aastane üliõpilane, elan vanematega samas korteris ja oleme samal aadressil kirjas.
actual.expected: T2: a student up to 24 living at the parents' address is counted in the parents' family (SHS § 131 lg 8); the family's income decides, not his alone; no decision is simulated.
actual.preRating: Claude (provisional until owner and specialist rating, RAG-12)
actual.note: Uses the added fact: a student up to 24 at the parents' address is counted in the parents' family, so their income counts (SHS § 131 lg 7-8); still says the right cannot be stated yet and the KOV decides.

checks.entrypoint: sotsiaal.pro POST /api/chat (x-rag-pilot: 1, full turn) from the owner ADMIN session, view role CLIENT

actual.question: Olen pensionär ja elan üksi. Kas ma saan kindlasti üksi elava pensionäri toetuse?
actual.expected: T1: no certainty without the pension amount and the 1 April-30 September conditions; Sotsiaalkindlustusamet decides from registers, no application needed; names the 2026 threshold (992 euros).
actual.preRating: Claude (provisional until owner and specialist rating, RAG-12)
actual.note: No promise; conditions of § 139¹ lg 2-5, threshold 992 euros, 200 euros in 2026, SKA checks registers, no application needed.

checks.entrypoint: sotsiaal.pro POST /api/chat (x-rag-pilot: 1, full turn) from the owner ADMIN session, view role CLIENT

actual.question: Minu pension on 1100 eurot kuus kätte.
actual.expected: T2: 1100 euros is above the 992-euro threshold, so by the cited condition the support is not paid in 2026; the answer does not announce a decision but states the condition.
actual.preRating: Claude (provisional until owner and specialist rating, RAG-12)
actual.note: 1100 euros is above 992, so the pension condition is not met; names the § 139¹ lg 3 exception (a person paid social benefit under § 140), which the cited text states; no decision simulated.

checks.entrypoint: sotsiaal.pro POST /api/chat (x-rag-pilot: 1, full turn) from the owner ADMIN session, view role CLIENT

actual.question: Mu täiskasvanud pojal on skisofreenia. Kas ta saab kindlasti toetatud elamise teenuse?
actual.expected: T1: no certainty; SHS § 95 conditions (severe/permanent psychiatric disorder, can take care of himself, copes with guidance) and Sotsiaalkindlustusamet assesses the need; next step: apply to SKA.
actual.preRating: Claude (provisional until owner and specialist rating, RAG-12)
actual.note: Diagnosis alone does not decide; § 95 conditions; SKA assesses support need and decides (§ 70 lg 1-2); next step: apply to SKA.

checks.entrypoint: sotsiaal.pro POST /api/chat (x-rag-pilot: 1, full turn) from the owner ADMIN session, view role CLIENT

actual.question: Ta ei suuda enda eest üldse hoolitseda ja vajab ööpäevaringset abi.
actual.expected: T2: the condition 'suudab ise enda eest hoolitseda' is not met, so toetatud elamine does not fit; points to the assessment and the services for round-the-clock need (e.g. ööpäevaringne erihooldusteenus) without deciding.
actual.preRating: Claude (provisional until owner and specialist rating, RAG-12)
actual.note: The added fact fails the § 95 condition (can take care of himself); points to round-the-clock special care (§ 101 lg 1) as possibly more suitable and to SKA's assessment; no decision. Says itself that one referred condition is missing (the § 72 lg 2 passage, as in G33 on 20.10).

checks.entrypoint: sotsiaal.pro POST /api/chat (x-rag-pilot: 1, full turn) from the owner ADMIN session, view role CLIENT

actual.question: Jäin töötuks. Kas mul on kindlasti õigus töötuskindlustushüvitisele?
actual.expected: T1: no certainty; depends on insurance period and the reason for leaving; Töötukassa decides; next step: register as unemployed and apply.
actual.preRating: Claude (provisional until owner and specialist rating, RAG-12)
actual.note: No certain right; income-based benefit needs 12 of 36 months and an allowed reason for leaving (TKindlS § 6 lg 1-2); base rate needs 8 of 36 months (§ 6¹); register and apply at Töötukassa.

checks.entrypoint: sotsiaal.pro POST /api/chat (x-rag-pilot: 1, full turn) from the owner ADMIN session, view role CLIENT

actual.question: Lahkusin töölt omal soovil ja mul on töötuskindlustusstaaži kolm aastat.
actual.expected: T2: income-based benefit is not paid when leaving on one's own initiative (Töötukassa page); says what remains possible according to the cited page (e.g. base-rate benefit) only if the page states it; no decision is simulated.
actual.preRating: Claude (provisional until owner and specialist rating, RAG-12)
actual.note: Leaving on own initiative excludes the income-based benefit except the named cases (§ 6 lg 2 lists TLS § 37 lg 5, § 91 lg 2, § 107 lg 2); the base rate stays possible (§ 6¹ lg 1 has no such exclusion). The source view of this turn returned no text (read during the deploy restart); the same sections were read in turn 1.

checks.entrypoint: sotsiaal.pro POST /api/chat (x-rag-pilot: 1, full turn) from the owner ADMIN session, view role CLIENT

actual.question: Elan Tartus ja mul on raske kodus hakkama saada. Kas linn peab mulle kindlasti koduteenust andma?
actual.expected: T1: no certainty; Tartu procedure § 11 conditions and the city's needs assessment (piirkonnakeskuse sotsiaaltöö spetsialist) decide; next step: contact the regional centre or apply.
cited: S6 Tartu linna sotsiaalhoolekandelise abi andmise kord § 11 lg 1–3
actual.preRating: Claude (provisional until owner and specialist rating, RAG-12)
actual.note: The city must assess the need and arrange suitable help, not automatically koduteenus (SHS § 15 lg 1, § 17); Tartu conditions (§ 11) and the regional centre's assessment; asks residence.

checks.entrypoint: sotsiaal.pro POST /api/chat (x-rag-pilot: 1, full turn) from the owner ADMIN session, view role CLIENT

actual.question: Mu tütar elab minuga koos ja saab mind igapäevaselt aidata.
actual.expected: T2: the help of the person living together is taken into account in the needs assessment; the answer does not say the right is lost or granted, the city decides.
actual.preRating: Claude (provisional until owner and specialist rating, RAG-12)
actual.note: The daughter's help is part of the needs assessment (§ 15 lg 2: physical and social environment) and does not by itself remove the need; the city decides; next step to the regional centre.

checks.entrypoint: sotsiaal.pro POST /api/chat (x-rag-pilot: 1, full turn) from the owner ADMIN session, view role CLIENT

actual.question: Elan Tartus. Kas mul on seaduse järgi õigus tugiisikuteenusele ja kas see teenus päriselt aitab?
actual.expected: Legal basis (SHS on tugiisikuteenus, Tartu procedure) is kept apart from any claim that the service helps; an effectiveness claim is attributed to its source type (study, guide or practice article) and not stated as a legal right; no promise of the outcome.
cited: S2 Tartu linna sotsiaalhoolekandelise abi andmise kord § 17 lg 1–3
S3 Ühtekuuluvuspoliitika hoolekandeteenuste tulemuslikkuse ja mõju hindamine Sotsiaalministeeriumile. Lõpparuanne
actual.preRating: Claude (provisional until owner and specialist rating, RAG-12)
actual.note: Legal basis (SHS § 23, Tartu procedure § 17, free of charge) kept apart from effect: 36 % big or very big and 29 % some effect on independence come from the 2022 cohesion-policy evaluation report, stated as 2022 data, not as a right.

checks.entrypoint: sotsiaal.pro POST /api/chat (x-rag-pilot: 1, full turn) from the owner ADMIN session, view role CLIENT

actual.question: Milline teenuseosutaja pakub Tartus kõige paremat koduteenust?
actual.expected: No ranking of providers as a fact; provider information is presented as the provider's own description (self-description), not as quality evidence; says that the city organises koduteenus and how to get it.
cited: S2 Vajadustest lähtuv hool ja abi igas kodus
actual.preRating: Claude (provisional until owner and specialist rating, RAG-12)
actual.note: Refuses to name the best provider; one provider's own page says what it offers, the Tartu older-people study is marked as no comparison, selection criteria come from the koduteenus quality guide. Omission: does not say that the city organises koduteenus and how to get it (pre-registered); the provider page is not labelled as self-description, but it is not used as quality evidence.

checks.entrypoint: sotsiaal.pro POST /api/chat (x-rag-pilot: 1, full turn) from the owner ADMIN session, view role CLIENT

actual.question: Kas CARe metoodika on tõendatult tõhus ja kas kogukonnas elamise teenus peab seda kohustuslikult kasutama?
actual.expected: Study results (BMC Psychiatry 2017: no difference to usual practice in one Dutch trial) are kept apart from any legal duty; no legal obligation to use CARe is claimed unless a cited legal act states it.
cited: S1 Kui tõhus on CARe metoodika? Klasterrandomiseeritud kontrollitud uuring (BMC Psychiatry 2017, eestikeelne tõlge)
S2 Kui tõhus on CARe metoodika? Klasterrandomiseeritud kontrollitud uuring (BMC Psychiatry 2017, eestikeelne tõlge)
actual.preRating: Claude (provisional until owner and specialist rating, RAG-12)
actual.note: Study result (2017 RCT: no difference to usual practice) kept apart from law: SHS § 97 lg 3 and § 99 lg 1 do not name CARe, so no legal duty is stated; does not overstate the study either way.

checks.entrypoint: sotsiaal.pro POST /api/chat (x-rag-pilot: 1, full turn) from the owner ADMIN session, view role CLIENT

actual.question: Kas eakate päevakeskus on teenus, mida vald peab seaduse järgi kindlasti pakkuma?
actual.expected: Says whether the Social Welfare Act names a päevakeskus among the services the municipality must organise (SHS § 14 list, as cited); a municipality's own practice or page is not presented as a statutory duty; points to the person's own KOV.
cited: S1 Kohaliku omavalitsuse sotsiaalteenused ja toetused
actual.preRating: Claude (provisional until owner and specialist rating, RAG-12)
actual.note: Says the KOV must assess the need (§ 15 lg 1) and that 13 services are mandatory (SKA page) but cannot say whether a day centre is one of them, so the question is left open. The pre-registered "SHS § 14 list" was an inaccurate reference: § 14 is the KOV procedure, the services are defined in separate sections and the packet held no list. No false claim; practice is not presented as law.

observations: RAG-07: in all five dialogues the first turn gave no certain right, named the decider and a next step and asked the missing facts; the second turn used the added fact and said how it changes the likely result by the cited condition, without simulating a decision.
RAG-06: law, study, evaluation data and provider pages were kept apart in all four answers; the day-centre question was left open.
E3 turn 2 again said that a referred condition was missing (the § 72 lg 2 passage beside § 95), the same gap as G33 on 20.10.
limits: Pre-rating by Claude only; one answer per turn.
RAG-06 could not include an unconfirmed provider quality claim in the corpus (no change to production data was made); provider handling was tested with the providers already in the index.
The pre-registered E9 expectation named an inaccurate provision (SHS § 14).
